description: WebGL globe (deck.gl or CesiumJS) that renders any feed402 dataset by hitting its query tier with a (bbox, time_range) filter. Layer toggle = one per domain bead. Time slider scrubs 4000 BCE → present. Click a point → fetch insight tier → side-panel narrative. Hosted at viz.bucket.foundation (subdomain TBD). Bead depends on at least 3 domain endpoints being live (pharma + world-history + constitutions = good demo set).
title: Globe viz frontend (3D + time slider) consuming feed402 endpoints

description: Sources: Comparative Constitutions Project (CCP, CC-BY), Constitute Project (CC-BY-NC — flag), constitutional texts from official gov sources (mostly public). Geo: national centroid + capital. Time: ratification, amendments. Schema: country_iso, doc_type, ratification_date, amendments_count, full_text_url, source, license. Tiers: raw=ratification events CSV, query=by clause/right/era, insight=rights-evolution narrative.
notes: v0 LIVE. 109 national constitutions w/ adoption date + capital-city coords from Wikidata SPARQL (CC0 data, CC-BY-SA-4.0 desc). gdrive:.../research/constitutions-canon/2026-04-27/. Next: layer CCP variables (clauses/rights), add amendments timeline.
title: National constitutions dataset → feed402 + globe

description: Sources to evaluate: FDA Orange Book (drug approvals, public domain), DailyMed (NLM, public), DrugBank (academic license), WHO ICD/ATC, EU EMA EPAR, openFDA adverse events, ClinicalTrials.gov (already partial in x402-rg), PubChem. Geo: manufacturer HQ, trial sites (lat,lon). Time: approval date, withdrawal date, trial start/end. Schema: drug_id, name, atc_code, approval_date, regulator, trial_site_lat, trial_site_lon, source_url, license. Tiers: raw=full Orange Book CSV, query=by ATC/region/year, insight=safety-signal summary. License audit MUST be first task — DrugBank academic-only.
notes: v0 LIVE. 1,375 FDA drug approvals (openFDA, public domain) at /home/gian/agfarms/feed402/packages/ingest-harness/datasets/pharma-fda/. 24.6% geocoded via 50-sponsor HQ table. /query bbox+date+filter works (verified: Abbvie/Teva 2020-2024 US). /insight ranks ENFLONSIA top for 'monoclonal antibody cancer'. Mirrored to gdrive:AGFarms/Nucleus/research/pharma-canon/2026-04-27/. Next: scale to full 29k corpus + add WHO ATC + add EMA EPAR + improve geocoding via openFDA labeler establishment addresses.
title: Pharmaceuticals dataset → feed402 + globe

description: Sources: Seshat Global History Databank (CC-BY), Wikidata historical events, Pleiades (ancient places, CC-BY), DPLA, Old World battles. Geo: site lat/lon. Time: 4000 BCE–present. notes: v0 LIVE. 828 unique geo+time-coded historical events from Wikidata SPARQL across 10 instance-of slices (battle/war/treaty/revolution/earthquake/epidemic/election/coup/expedition). License clean: Wikidata CC0 + linked descriptions CC-BY-SA-4.0. /query verified for Pacific Rim earthquakes 1700s. /insight ranks naval battles correctly.
